choice.basis: The dashboard shows the Reservoir Storage Level Index decreased from 23.9 in 2005 to 10.1 in 2014, a full-period drop of 13.8 points. This represents a decline of approximately 58% over the review period, which is a significant magnitude of change. Although a specific numerical threshold is not explicitly defined in the text, a change of this scale (nearly 60% reduction) clearly exceeds the scope of 'ordinary variation' and warrants 'substantial-change follow-up' rather than routine monitoring or archiving.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up
